mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, order_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{payload}, #{status}, 0, NOW(3), NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, event_type, topic, payload, status, retry_count, claim_token FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'NEW' OR (status = 'RETRY' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND lease_until <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'SENDING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('NEW', 'RETRY', 'SENDING')

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, sent_time = NOW(3), last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'RETRY', claim_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
